prompts.name: tea_sip
prompts.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet for the existing Cinnamoroll desktop pet. Use the attached snack sheet only as STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE. Match exactly its warm caramel-brown smooth outline, soft white body, cyan oval eyes, pink cheeks, tiny cinnamon curl tail, very long floppy ears, soft flat pastel shading and proportions. NEW ACTION: Tea sip. Exactly 8 distinct animation frames in a perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, read left to right top then bottom. Each identical cell has transparent padding, same character scale, same horizontal center, and the exact same feet baseline. Whole character and both ears entirely inside EVERY cell, clear spacing between cells; no dividers, text, labels or numbers. Sequence: 1 holds a small pale blue teacup with BOTH front paws below chin; 2 lifts cup slightly; 3 cup touches mouth eyes close; 4 gentle sip; 5 cup lowers slightly; 6 happy rosy cheeks and closed-eye smile; 7 cup held low, eyes open; 8 returns to first pose for a smooth loop. Only TWO front paws visible, both attached to shoulders. No extra arms, floating utensils, tabletop, bed, floor or background. Keep body volume and outline registration consistent, no bouncing. Real transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard image.
